title: olea europaea var. strobilina
intro: Olea europaea var. strobilina, commonly known as wild olive, is a variety of the olive tree that is native to the Mediterranean region. It is valued for its health benefits, which include anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties that may help protect against cell damage and promote overall well-being. The therapeutic actions of wild olive include antimicrobial and antiviral effects, as well as the ability to support heart health and reduce stress. The bioactive constituents of wild olive include saponins, flavonoids, and phenolic acids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
